chats.answer:
The best all-in-one solar inverter charger depends on whether you're building an off-grid system, a home battery backup system, or a hybrid solar system connected to the utility grid.

For most residential applications, I'd focus on EG4, Sol-Ark, Victron, and Growatt.

A good all-in-one unit should combine an MPPT solar charge controller, pure sine wave inverter, battery charger, and automatic AC transfer functionality. Some models also support grid export and generator integration.
